meta.title: Quickstart: pipeline run · {brand}
meta.description: Run a pinned pipeline version on a recording and read its run record and provenance.

heading: Run a pinned pipeline.
lede: A pipeline version is identified by the hash of its steps, images, parameters and seed. The SDK recomputes that hash locally, so a pipeline cannot change under a name.

sections.heading: Resolve a version
body: A reference is name@version or a content ID (pv:sha256:...). Every parameter is explicit, defaults included.

lines: print(pipe.id)                                   # recomputed by the SDK core

sections.heading: Run it
body: run queues the pipeline on a recording and returns at once. A local file is uploaded first. wait polls until the run ends and raises if it failed.

sections.heading: Read the run record
body: The run record holds every resolved parameter, the seed, thread pins and library versions. Outputs are listed only after their provenance is committed.

lines: print([(a["step"], a["name"]) for a in run.artifacts][:3])
